## Summary

**Case CASE-005 — classified as `fx_difference`**

**What happened:** The same vendor payment appears on both sides, but the ledger used a different exchange rate than the bank.

| | Foreign amount | Rate | USD |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ledger GL-0053 (2026-08-11) | EUR 3,812.11 | 1.1000 | −4,193.32 |
| Bank BNK-0054 (2026-08-12) | EUR 3,812.11 | 1.1197 | −4,268.42 |
| Difference | — | — | **−75.10** |

**Key evidence:**
- **DOC-003** (vendor bill): EUR 3,812.11 due to Ross, Robinson and Bright — confirms the correct foreign-currency amount.
- **DOC-025** (bank wire confirmation): EUR 3,812.11 sent at rate 1.1197, USD 4,268.42 debited — independently corroborates the bank line.
- **BILL-5058** appears exactly once at the bank and once in the ledger, and is not matched elsewhere — ruling out duplicate or timing explanations. The identical EUR amount rules out a wrong-amount posting; only the rate differs.

**Proposed fix (pending human approval — nothing has been posted):** Debit 7100 FX Gain/Loss 75.10 / Credit 1000 Cash - Operating 75.10, recognising the unfavourable rate movement and bringing recorded cash in line with the USD 4,268.42 actually debited.

**One flag for the reviewer:** DOC-025 mentions a separate USD 35.00 wire fee debited independently. It is outside this case's bank line and ledger entry, so I deliberately excluded it; if it surfaces as its own unreconciled bank line, it should be resolved under a separate case.

input.explanation: Same transaction on both sides, differing only by the exchange rate used. Vendor bill DOC-003 is for EUR 3,812.11 to Ross, Robinson and Bright (due 2026-08-15). Ledger entry GL-0053 (2026-08-11) records the payment of EUR 3,812.11 converted at 1.1000 = USD 4,193.32. Bank line BNK-0054 (value date 2026-08-12) shows the same EUR 3,812.11 wire, but the bank applied 1.1197, debiting USD 4,268.42; wire confirmation DOC-025 independently confirms EUR 3,812.11 at rate 1.1197 and USD 4,268.42 debited. The foreign-currency amount is identical on both sides and this is the only appearance of BILL-5058 in the bank and ledger data (no duplicate, no reference matched elsewhere), so this is not an amount-entry error or a timing issue — it is purely an FX rate difference of USD 75.10 (4,268.42 - 4,193.32), an unfavourable FX loss because the actual rate was higher than the booked rate. Proposed fix: debit 7100 FX Gain/Loss USD 75.10 and credit 1000 Cash - Operating USD 75.10, bringing the recorded cash outflow to the USD 4,268.42 the bank actually took. Note for the reviewer: DOC-025 also states a separate USD 35.00 wire fee was debited; that charge is not part of this case's bank line or ledger entry and is not included in this entry — if it appears as its own unreconciled bank line it should be handled under its own case.
